description.value: The Gull Liquor Store bills itself as the largest private liquor store on the North Shore, stocking over 5,000 beer, wine, RTD, cider, and spirits options from local BC producers to international imports. Located in the Park and Tilford Mall on Brooksbank Avenue, it is locally owned and operated with knowledgeable staff and same-day delivery available. Friday and Saturday in-store tastings with winemakers, distillers, and brewers give it a community-focused character beyond a typical bottle shop.

address.value: 900–333 Brooksbank Ave, North Vancouver, BC V7J 3S8
